<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, flexibility, and round-the-clock productivity are the hallmarks of [Pinnacle Logistics Partners]. Our fast and flexible onsite/remote, global 24x7 delivery model lends itself to a full spectrum of contract services - from rail scheduling, port operations support, and systems modernization to full logistics management, including equipment maintenance and fleet coordination.

We can offer Tasman Ridge Resources our Certified SAP and Oracle professionals are available at A$28/hr to work on your projects. We have nearly 500 employees and state of the art operations facilities. Our service centers in Brisbane are considered the "crown jewel" of our network and is a key distinguisher for you.

https://www.pinnaclelogistics.com.au/

Over the years, our Global Technical Centers (GTCs) in Brisbane have achieved an impressive record of project accomplishments for our Australian, European, and Asian customers.

Our Innovation Centers (IC's) and GTC's offer the following capabilities for our customers:

   a.. Bulk commodity scheduling optimization
   b.. Rail network integration and Marcus Chen
   c.. Port throughput re-engineering Services
   d.. Legacy system migration Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk/ Call Center Support Services

Although all of our services can be accomplished in one of our regional offices, our customers gain significant added value by utilizing the power of our global delivery capabilities. Please visit https://www.pinnaclelogistics.com.au/

This 24x7 development and delivery model enables Pinnacle Logistics Partners to scale project staffing rapidly to meet client needs, to engage in concurrent operations support and to employ a virtual 24-hour work day on client projects.

Darren, Please let us know if we can set a quick meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.

Regards,
